s01932.summary: A drenched, bleeding stranger knocks at widow Agnes's door and asks for a fire.
Agnes lets him in, bolts the door, and tends his wound warily.
Agnes lays a hunting knife between them and asks what is in his satchel.
Learning Agnes buried his brother, he stands; she grips the knife and he demands the grave.
Agnes lowers the knife; Julian says his brother's letters spoke lovingly of her.
Agnes weeps at the news and they walk out together to the grave.

s02506.summary: Colm and June pass a dull stakeout with dry banter about food and boredom.
A neighbor knocks, suspecting a stakeout; Colm claims they are the gas company.
Felicity gives them sandwiches and promises tea at four before leaving.
June and Colm eat, decide to stay, and joke about the egg salad smell.

s01927.summary: Salesman Len naps on a showroom bed and tells owner Milton it is research.
Phyllis phones to return a 1998 mattress, then reveals she is calling from it.

s01130.summary: Wren and Kojo wheel stolen cash from a brewery vault while Maeve monitors the guard.
The guard arrives early and the thieves duck behind a vat.
Holt finds the dolly tracks and calmly greets the thieves as they surrender.
Holt, bitter over his cut pension, lets them go and tells Maeve they are coming.

s01465.summary: Cleo searches archive cabinets while guard Silas follows, humming and chatting.
Silas knows the file she wants, drops his keys in her hand, and claims he waited forty years.
Cleo finds the red-tied folder and asks why he did not take it himself.
Silas jokes that guards get robbed; Cleo laughs, kisses his cheek, and runs.

s00553.summary: After a seven-pin loss, Huxley, Dexter and Romeo dissect the tenth frame.
Dexter jokes about a beer and his split; the three break into laughter.
Huxley turns the loss into progress and rallies them to say hello next season.
As cheering dies, Huxley writes NEXT YEAR on his clipboard.

s02240.summary: Ines's family takes Aunt Seraphina's dinner call on speaker, joking about scarves.
Gideon arrives soaked, two days late; Ines stiffens and the room goes quiet.
Nobody moves until little Tuan holds up his drawing for his father.

s00809.summary: Driver Eldon announces a stop to a nearly empty bus on a rainy night.
Soraya learns the bus isn't going to Eastgate and asks to get off early.
Eldon opens the doors at Harbor and Fifth; Bennett stays seated and Soraya hesitates.
Eldon asks the empty seats to leave; Bennett says he speaks to those who stayed.

s01773.summary: Dewey, Lonnie and Frankie bicker on the concession roof about their secret film.
Frankie worries about the reel as the western reaches its gunfight below.
The three sit together and plan more films with real stunts and capes.
At intermission Frankie and Lonnie rush to the booth while Dewey watches the lot.
Their hand-cut film flares on the screen and the cars honk in approval.

s01568.summary: Estranged sister Lavinia enters the sleeper compartment as the conductor checks tickets.
The sisters make stiff small talk about the sea; Wendell recalls seeing it with Clementine.
Lavinia apologizes for not writing and admits a failed romance; Wendell goes for tea.
Alone, the sisters share a smile and Clementine holds the tearful Lavinia.
Wendell returns with tea, sees them embracing, and quietly steps back out.

s02247.summary: Rasmus returns home thin and Ottilie scolds him for never writing.
Ottilie condemns Rasmus for selling his father's boat; they shout and she strikes the table.
Rasmus says someone kept his letters; Ottilie pales and opens a drawer of envelopes.
Ottilie admits she could not read them from shame; Rasmus covers her hand.

s00838.summary: The crew races to crack a floor safe as a police car approaches.
In the dark everyone freezes as a flashlight passes and the car pulls away.
Mabel opens the safe and Fox orders them to grab the bags.

s01158.summary: Detective Rafferty shows Tully an engraved watch; Tully denies knowing it.
Rafferty keeps the foreman in the office and questions him about the night shift.
Rafferty lists evidence tying a harbor corpse to Tully's plant.
Federal Agent Corvo enters and raises the cocaine hidden in Tully's tuna.
Rafferty hands the case to Corvo while Halvorsen flees down the stairs.

s00965.summary: Bunny counts cash while Delia calms jittery Gus, who wants to leave.
Delia peels an orange and offers Gus a segment; he takes it uneaten.
The shop bell rings, a truck door slams, and Gus recognizes his father's truck.
Bunny takes a revolver from the drawer as the bell rings again.

s01530_1.summary: Nadezhda is trapped in a stairwell as doors open above and below.
She reads the label on the flash drive in her own hand and panics.
She spots a vent, pries the grille, and climbs in as boots arrive.

s00151.summary: Ray and trainee Tanisha wait at the car wash as Marcus's sedan emerges.
Marcus inspects the trunk, praises Ray, and tucks three twenties into his pocket.
Ray tells Tanisha nothing was in the trunk, and Marcus drives off.
Ray's hand trembles as he pockets the bills and turns on the hose.

s02380.summary: Ser Aldric enters a mountain forge where Broda tells him the sword isn't ready.
Aldric learns the Lady sleeps and touches her cheek far longer than courtesy allows.
Broda asks why he traveled so far; he says he keeps a promise to a dead man.
Tibb lifts a glowing coal unburnt; Broda points the blade at the door and tells Aldric to ask for the sword.

s01701.summary: A young woman sneaks into the observatory; an old professor appears with a lantern.
Caught, Ottoline pleads to look and says she wrote eleven letters; the professor softens.
He asks to be shown; Ottoline adjusts the telescope and he gasps.

s00786.summary: Vivienne plays her recorded message promising to meet someone at nine, now long past.
She replays the recording, paces, and finds the blue tie in the closet.
She says he never came, flings the tie, and smashes the recorder into the mirror.
A last crackle says 'I'll wait' and Vivienne sinks to the floor.

s00938.summary: Lawrence serves roast, skipping Teddy, and praises Claudia's promotion.
Lawrence needles Teddy and announces the office lease will not be renewed.
Lawrence says Teddy has had five years; Teddy answers it was five years of being watched.
Claudia and Margaret clear the table; Teddy refuses to sit and Lawrence's hand trembles.

s02214.summary: Tycoon Adler-Moss sweats with a pistol while Nadine sits silent and police arrive downstairs.
Nadine slides him a notarised paper bearing his signature; he blanches.
Nadine cuts the phone line; Adler-Moss grabs the pistol and threatens to shoot.
The gun is empty; Nadine says she was there since lunch as police climb up.

s00221.summary: A woman finds a stranger at the planetarium console and wary talk begins.
The stranger evades her questions, then claims her dead husband knew him.
She holds up a key to the basement reels and asks his name.
Desmond gives his name, she leaves the key and twenty minutes, and he takes it.

s00927.summary: The judge enters small claims court with an unrepresented defendant, Dutch.
Felipe withdraws the claim just as Dutch offers to pay; the judge demands an explanation.

s01556_4.summary: Nell mounts the mule and turns away from Cheyenne, leaving the homestead behind.

s00615.summary: Patrons rest in a coaching inn while a wounded soldier warms himself by the fire.
Elijah answers rumors of Bonaparte and tells them the Emperor was beaten at Waterloo.
The room exhales as Elijah murmurs he wishes it felt like victory.

s00532.summary: During a power cut, Nana orders bowls while the family bickers in the dark.
Thunder startles everyone; Nana quietly serves her grandson and touches his hair.

s00936.summary: Rudy sits with coffee in the Zamboni garage before dawn.
Marisol arrives and exchanges their ritual nod; they talk about the ice.
Coach Dahlia arrives and trades terse early-bird lines with Marisol.
Marisol spots Phoebe lacing alone; her shoulders tighten and ease, a quiet hello.
Rudy fires up the Zamboni and the skaters step silently onto fresh ice.
